report: You're 2-8 and four starters are on bye: Stafford, Stevenson, the Seattle kicker and the Rams defense. Start Ryan Flournoy at flex for Stevenson. He has 10.29 PPR a game, 13.17 over his last 3, a 97% snap share, and Tennessee gives up the most points to WRs (rank 1). Pick up Cam Ward at QB (13.3 average, 17.05 last 3, Dallas gives up the 5th-most QB points, rank 5), dropping the injured Pierre Strong. I found no kicker or defense in the free-agent list, so check the Sleeper kicker and defense pool for this week. The best trade to send is Ladd McConkey-free: send Omar Cooper Jr. to Cavery11 for D'Andre Swift (17.09 a game), which upgrades your weak second RB spot (White, 9.74) by about 7 points.

team_breakdown.note: Stafford is 16.26 with a 9.4 floor, but he is on bye, he is 38, and his last 3 average is 13.09.
Javonte Williams is 16.73 but his last 3 is 12.27. White (9.74) and Stevenson (11.52) are weak starters.
Higgins is 19.04 (23.1 last 3) and McMillan is 14.56. Flournoy and Cooper Jr. (15.65) add depth, but Cooper is out.
LaPorta is 10.63 but only 5.43 over his last 3. Mayer (8.56) is the backup.
Jameson Williams (12.74) and Flournoy (10.29) are steady, with nobody who scores 15 or more.
McConkey and Cooper are out. Black (5.81) and McGowan (4.64) are only handcuff-level backups.

plan: Trade for an RB2 upgrade (Swift or Bucky Irving) to replace White's 9.74 a game.
Use the WR depth (Dell, Williams, Cooper) as trade chips, since Higgins, McMillan and Flournoy cover the starting spots.
Add a steadier TE (Kelce) and pick up Cam Ward at QB to cover the Stafford bye.
